Feature: S3 corpus source
  Scenario: Ingest items from Amazon S3
    Given a corpus configuration with a source kind of "s3" and valid bucket and prefix settings
    When I run corpus ingestion
    Then Biblicus registers items with provenance URIs in the s3 scheme
    And retrieval evidence references those item identifiers
